violations.text: An allergen statement is lacking on munus and/or point of sale. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. PIC provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026
Coffee residue was observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was in excess of 400 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be ( ) ppm. Staff diluted to proper concentration. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026
Leaks were observed at the following: -3-bay faucet -3-bay spray hose -3-bay drain. PIC stated work orders are in place. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 06/12/2026
